skill.name: swarm-planner
skill.description: Creates dependency-aware implementation plans for parallel multi-agent execution after codebase research, clarification, documentation review, and subagent validation.
skill.summary: Plan complex implementation work as validated, dependency-aware tasks that agents can execute in parallel.
skill.author: am-will

content.value_statement: Complex implementations often hide dependencies and block parallel work. This skill researches the codebase and produces validated, dependency-aware plans for coordinated agent execution.
actual_capabilities: Investigates architecture, existing implementations, dependencies, and frameworks before planning.
Retrieves current documentation through Context7 or web search for external libraries, frameworks, and APIs.
Requests clarification when architecture, scope, constraints, or priorities are ambiguous.
Defines atomic tasks with identifiers, dependencies, file locations, descriptions, and validation criteria.
Organizes ready tasks into parallel execution groups and a dependency graph.
Saves a Markdown plan in the current directory and requests subagent review.
limitations: Produces implementation plans and does not implement them.
Requires Context7 or web access for current external documentation.
Depends on repository access, user clarification, and subagent availability for the complete workflow.

use_cases.title: Plan a Service Migration
use_cases.description: Map schema, repository, service, endpoint, and test changes into ordered tasks with clear parallel work.

use_cases.title: Coordinate a Product Feature
use_cases.description: Separate frontend, backend, data, and validation work while preserving dependencies across teams.

use_cases.title: Prepare an Agent Work Queue
use_cases.description: Convert a complex repository change into atomic tasks that multiple coding agents can execute.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Small Feature
prompt_templates.prompt: Use swarm-planner to plan adding [feature] to this repository. Ask about unclear requirements before creating the dependency-aware plan.
prompt_templates.scenario: A beginner needs a structured plan for a focused repository change.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Cross-Layer Change
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan [change] across the interface, service, data, and test layers. Identify task dependencies, file locations, validation criteria, and parallel execution groups.
prompt_templates.scenario: A feature affects several application layers.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Framework Migration
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a migration plan from [current framework or version] to [target]. Research current documentation, identify risks, and order compatibility, migration, and testing tasks.
prompt_templates.scenario: A team needs current documentation and careful sequencing for a migration.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Constrained Multi-Agent Delivery
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a swarm-ready plan for [objective] under [constraints]. Inspect existing patterns, resolve ambiguity, define atomic tasks, map dependencies, group parallel waves, and request subagent review.
prompt_templates.scenario: An advanced project has architectural constraints, multiple workstreams, and strict validation requirements.

output_examples.input: Plan passwordless authentication for the existing web application.
output_examples.output: The plan starts with architecture and provider decisions, then separates schema, service, interface, and test tasks into dependency-based execution waves.

output_examples.input: Plan an upgrade of the application framework without interrupting active feature work.
output_examples.output: The result identifies compatibility research, package updates, migration work, regression testing, and rollout checks with explicit prerequisites and parallel opportunities.

output_examples.input: Plan a reporting feature that requires new data aggregation and a dashboard.
output_examples.output: The plan coordinates data contracts, aggregation logic, API work, dashboard development, and integration tests while marking which tasks can begin together.

best_practices: Provide the objective, constraints, priorities, and acceptance criteria before planning begins.
Answer clarification questions with concrete repository and product context.
Review dependency links and validation criteria before assigning tasks to agents.
anti_patterns: Do not use the skill when implementation should begin immediately without a planning phase.
Do not omit known constraints and expect the planner to infer business priorities.
Do not assign dependent tasks in parallel before their prerequisites are complete.

faq.question: Does this skill implement the plan?
faq.answer: No. It creates and reviews the implementation plan but does not modify the planned product code.

faq.question: When does the skill run?
faq.answer: It runs only through explicit invocation.

faq.question: Why does it ask clarification questions?
faq.answer: Clarification reduces incorrect assumptions about architecture, scope, constraints, and priorities.

faq.question: How are parallel tasks identified?
faq.answer: Tasks with empty or satisfied dependency lists are grouped into execution waves that can start together.

faq.question: Does it use current external documentation?
faq.answer: Yes. It requests Context7 documentation for external dependencies and uses web search when Context7 is unavailable.

faq.question: Where is the finished plan stored?
faq.answer: The skill saves a topic-named Markdown plan in the current working directory.
